ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows two cascaded amplifier stages labeled A1 and A2. The signal ui enters through resistor R1 to the input node at the inverting terminal of A1, while the non-inverting terminal of A1 is grounded. The output of A1 drives the non-inverting input of A2, and A2 produces the final output uo. A resistor R2 is connected from the final output node uo back to the same input node of A1 where R1 connects, i.e., the inverting summing node. Reasoning: Since R2 takes the feedback signal from the output voltage node uo, the output sampling is voltage sampling. Since the feedback current through R2 and the input current through R1 meet at the same input node, the mixing form is shunt mixing. Since this feedback is applied to the inverting terminal of A1, it is negative feedback. Therefore, the inter-stage feedback type is voltage shunt negative feedback.
